queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'JetBrains dotPeek%' AND publisher = 'JetBrains s.r.o.';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'JetBrains dotPeek%' AND publisher = 'JetBrains s.r.o.' AND version_compare(version, '2026.2.1') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) IN ('dotpeek32.exe','dotpeek64.exe','dotpeek64a.exe'));
